after.gpr_evidence_basis: In vitro activity of the purified Y. lipolytica proteins (Wang et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s13068-020-01815-8, Table 2): NADH-linked D-xylulose reduction and NAD+-linked D-arabitol oxidation; reaction products assigned from a 340 nm NAD(P)H assay, not identified
after.r1964_gene_function: YALI1F03452g (= YALI0F02211g, called YlAraDH1 in Wang 2020) and YALI1E06616g (= YALI0E05643g, called YlAraDH2); no verified gene names; NAD(H)-dependent short-chain polyol dehydrogenases also active on mannitol, D-sorbitol and xylitol in vitro; no deletion phenotype on glucose; experimental product identification required.
after.r1964_regiochemistry_limit: Whether these enzymes oxidize D-arabinitol at C-4 (D-xylulose, this reaction, EC 1.1.1.11) or at C-2 (D-ribulose, EC 1.1.1.250, the homology label on YALI1F03452g and R2190) is not settled: D-ribulose was never tested; a stereochemical reading of the measured substrate pattern favours C-4 (inferred); the 42 % identical fungal homologs form D-ribulose.
after.r1964_previous_annotation: bigg.reaction/vmhreaction ABTD1, metanetx.reaction MNXR154181 (L-arabinitol 4-dehydrogenase record pairing D-arabinitol with L-xylulose); replaced because m1015 is D-xylulose (MNXM1371292).
after.r1964_gpr_authorization: User authorized the opt-in provisional GPR YALI1F03452g or YALI1E06616g and the D-xylulose cross-references on 2026-10-19 (model/reports/r1964_gpr_20261019).
